title: Compliance Note — Floor Plan Turnover Allowance in Lease Term Agreement Lease Breaks
content:
The reletting fee of a lease break on a Lease Term Agreement includes a turnover allowance. The turnover allowance is set by the floor plan of the lease: a Three-Bedroom Residence or Penthouse Residence adds 100.00 dollars; a Two-Bedroom Residence or One-Bedroom Den Residence adds 50.00 dollars; any other floor plan adds nothing.

1. The floor plan read is the one leased on the Apartment Home Lease.
2. The part of the reletting fee obtained by applying the reletting rate to the contracted rent is rounded half up to the cent, and the allowance is then added to it.

| Floor plan on the Apartment Home Lease | Turnover allowance |
|---|---|
| Penthouse Residence | 100.00 dollars |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 100.00 dollars |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 50.00 dollars |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 50.00 dollars |
| One-Bedroom Residence | nothing |
| Studio Residence | nothing |

*Example (hypothetical).* A lease on a One-Bedroom Den Residence adds 50.00 dollars; a lease on a One-Bedroom Residence adds nothing.
